subject: Hightower vendor privacy intake — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list and PO path

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bob Singh <bob@hightower.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hightower vendor privacy intake — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list and PO path

Hi Bob —

Thanks for taking the meeting yesterday. Procurement needs a few artifacts to get Hightower set up in our vendor system and to route a PO. Can you please provide the following so we can finish the privacy/security gating and create the PO?

1) Executable Data Processing Agreement (PDF or DocuSign link) — if you have a preferred DPA, attach it; otherwise we can send ours.
2) SOC 2 report or a link to the hosted report + date/period covered (we require a 2026/2027 report).
3) Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred) and a brief note if any new subprocessors were added in the past 12 months.
4) Completed vendor intake form (attached) with billing contact, W9/tax info, and remit instructions for PO/invoice.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form_20280419.pdf (please return completed), sample PO template for your reference.

Timeline: Procurement has asked we complete the gate by EOD Friday so finance can cut the PO next week. If there are any legal tweaks to the DPA that need redlines, flag them here and loop in your counsel.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation and the SOC2 link if available.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
--- Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form_20280419.pdf (PDF) ---

From: Bob Singh <bob@hightower.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@hightower.ai
Date: 2028-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hightower vendor privacy intake — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list and PO path

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the intake form. Quick answers below and I attached the current subprocessor list.

• SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 (Type II) is hosted here: https://hightower.ai/security/soc2-report-2027 (covers 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31). If you need the full PDF we can push to a secure transfer.
• Subprocessors: See attached CSV: Hightower_Subprocessors_20280419.csv — we added CloudKeep (data cache) in Oct 2027 and no other changes since.
• DPA: We prefer our standard DPA for speed; signature via DocuSign is fastest. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-hightower-dpa. If Redwood prefers its template, send it over and our counsel will review (turnaround ~2–3 business days).
• Billing/W9: Billing contact is Accounting Ops <ap@hightower.ai>. Attached is our tax certificate and remit instructions.

Attachments: Hightower_Subprocessors_20280419.csv, Hightower_W9_2028.pdf (stub).

Let me know if you need an explicit subprocessor attestation for CloudKeep — we can provide a POA from that vendor.

Best,
Bob Singh
Head of Partnerships | Hightower AI
bob@hightower.ai
